project: Kidou Senshi Gundam: Gundam vs. Gundam NEXT PLUS Korean fan translation

public_korean_only_draft.note: The 2026-09-25 map and mission drafts are local-only for now; the public exporter only accepts EBOOT_05-digit IDs.

observations: MISSION 1 title and both description lines render in Korean.
With the patch-owned font, the main menu line now shows '2인 협력 플레이도 가능!' and '모드입니다.' with the digit and the full stop visible.

known_issue: Half-width ASCII, full-width Latin and kana do not render with the firmware font. Resolved by shipping a patch-owned font loaded through sceFontOpenUserFile: digits, English and punctuation now draw. The shipped subset comes from Sony's kr0.pgf, so a freely licensed font still has to be rasterised into a PGF before the patch can be distributed.

notation_policy.english: kept as English; now renders because the patch ships its own font
notation_policy.digits: restored to ASCII digits; the Hangul-numeral workaround was reverted once digits rendered again

english_and_digits.state: not displayable in translated message text
english_and_digits.workaround: quantities and durations are written as Hangul numerals
english_and_digits.next_step: trace the message path from the decoder callers at 0x08883364 / 0x088838F4 to the sceFont call

font_control.approach: repurpose an unused sceFont import slot for sceFontOpenUserFile and load the font with disc0:
font_control.decoder_change: Hangul base moved from 0xAC00 to 0x0100 so the font character map stays small
font_control.size_limit: the game's libfont fails to open user fonts above roughly 160-192KB
font_control.distribution_blocker: the current subset is extracted from Sony's kr0.pgf and cannot be redistributed; a free font must be rasterised into a PGF instead
